reason: This Lake transition registers independent ECPP, ordered-function, real-closure, RCF, sign-determination, Yun and selected-sign semantic proof, conformance and bench targets, and removes manual determinant experiments. It adds the pinned AINTLIB dependency for ECPP proofs; AINTLIB is outside the factorization service runtime import graph. The Mathlib pin, package compiler options, hexbz_factor_service executable and all factorization-library declarations are unchanged. The selected-sign registration adds only HexSignDetMathlib.SelectedProducer to HexQuerySemantics and HexSignDetMathlib.SelectedProducerConformance to HexConformance; neither target reaches the measured factorization executable.
